title: Tees Maar Khan
desc: Having escaped from abusive households, Tees Maar Khan and Vasudha form a familial bond. Years later, a tragedy involving the mafia leaves Tees Maar Khan vying for revenge.

title: Puli
desc: Marudheeran goes on a quest to bring back his love, Pavazhamalli, who was kidnapped by the Vedhalams, a group that possesses mystical powers. He must face Yavanarani, a sorceress, and her aide.

title: Kodeeswaran 3
desc: After succeeding at framing ACP Kishore, Satya goes on to become an international criminal. While he gets targeted by Interpol, Kishore seeks revenge on him too, upon being released from prison.

title: Pon Manickavel
desc: Pon Manickavel, IPS officer, is given the task to solve the case of a judge's murder. While his team attempts to crack the crime, the lives of high-profile persons are threatened.

title: Indian
desc: Frustrated with the rampant corruption in Indian bureaucracy, an army veteran takes it upon himself to reinstate law and justice in society.

title: Amma Ammaayiyamma
desc: Prabhavathy, one of five children, marries a rich businessman, Shekharankutty, and forgets about her family. Her husband decides to make her understand the importance of her family.
